===== [p104-104] ! CAUTION > As extra input functions, the following functions are available (2块) =====
--[p104]-- ¾[Designated Start Point -> Last Point : Use to set [Starting Point] and [Movement Count] so that lamination is executed from designated point to last point automatically.
Note: While frame feed is enabled, the machine does not execute the lamination to un-bonded paddle.
Note: The machine does not execute the lamination on paddle that was already laminated.
II) When the bonded frame is carried to lamination position by LM frame pitch feed In this case, “Manual Lamination” window appears.
On this window, lamination can be executed by specifying the lamination start paddle and number of paddle that are laminated at one time.
--[p104]-- As extra input functions, the following functions are available
¾[1<sup>st</sup> Point -> Last point]: Use to set [Starting Point] and [Movement Count] so that lamination is executed from 1<sup>st</sup> point to Last point automatically.
¾[Processed next Point -> Last point]: Use to set [Starting Point] and [Movement Count] so that lamination is executed from next point to last point automatically.

===== [p62-63] ! CAUTION > 4.3 Manual Operation (2块) =====
--[p62]-- 4.3 Manual Operation
Manual (step) operation is used for recovery works when error occurs and adjustment of the equipment.
To perform Manual operation, touch System button to go to System window.
For Manual operation, Manual, F Manual, L/UL Manual, P Manual, B Manual, LM Manual and LMF Manual buttons are provided on System window and, touching each button, each Step Operation window will appear.
\* [LM Manual] and [LMF Manual] are available for the DB800 that is equipped with Lamination unit.
--[p63]-- Navigation to other Manual Operation Window
On each Manual operation window, changeover buttons for each Manual operation are provided as in the above Feeder Window. By touching one of these buttons, it goes to a window of Manual operation desired.

===== [p30-32] DB-800 SERIES > ! CAUTION (6块) =====
--[p31]-- ! CAUTION
When wafer cassette moves up or down, hands or fingers may be in danger of pinching. In case this part is likely touched, make it sure that the main switch is turned off in advance.
--[p30]-- In addition, make it sure that the work is done after turning off the power of heating module and waiting for 40 minutes or more. Otherwise, it may result in burns.
Pre-bond heater, bond heater, post-bond heater, and Lamination stage heater are heated. Do not touch these heaters. In case this part is likely touched, make it sure that the main switch is turned off in advance.
--[p32]-- ! CAUTION
During frame loader is in action, hands or fingers may be in danger of pinching. In case this part is likely touched, make it sure that the main switch is turned off in advance.
--[p30]-- ! CAUTION
When a heating module is turned ON, do not touch the heating module and parts near the heating module. When the heating module and parts near the heating module should be touched, turn off power of the heating module and, wait for 40 minutes or more and then, wear protective equipment such as gloves and, further, use a jig (tool) in order not to touch the heating module or parts near the heating module by bare hands directly.
--[p31]-- ! CAUTION
When a wafer is being loaded or unloaded, hands or fingers may be in danger of pinching. In case this part is likely touched, make it sure that the main switch is turned off in advance.
--[p32]-- ! CAUTION
During dispensing motion, hands or fingers may be in danger of pinching. In case this part is likely touched, make it sure that the main switch is turned off in advance.

===== [p8-8] DB-800 SERIES > Note: Description in this manual (1块) =====
--[p8]-- Note: Description in this manual
(1) This manual describes all functions available at option from our company (including configuration). Since specifications differ customer by customer, be forewarned that unnecessary display for a certain customer may appear on the operation window.
(2) Meanwhile, do not operate any switch and the like that is not necessary for a certain customer as mentioned above. The system may not operate correctly.

===== [p76-76] ! CAUTION > 4.3.4.1 Preform by Specifying Die Pad (2块) =====
--[p76]-- 4.3.4.1 Preform by Specifying Die Pad
On this window, preform can be performed by specifying die pad No.
① Enter starting die pad No. for which preform is desired in the input field of Starting Die Pad.
② Enter number of die pads for which preform is desired in the input filed of No. of Operating Die Pads.
Press START switch so that preform will take place for die pad numbers programmed.
As extra input functions, the following functions are provided.
① 1st Die Pad → Last Die Pad
--[p76]-- Starting Die Pad and No. of Operating Die Pads are set to preform from the 1st die pad to last die pad.
② Next Process Die Pad → Last Die Pad
Starting Die Pad and No. of Operating Die Pads are set to preform from the die to process next time to last die pad.
③ Specified Starting Die Pad → Last Die Pad
No. of Operating Die Pads is set to preform from starting die pad to last die pad.

===== [p28-28] DB-800 SERIES > 3.6.3 Ionizer (1块) =====
--[p28 [表]]-- 3.6.3 Ionizer
DB-800 is equipped with ionizer. Content of ozone emitted from ionizer depends upon the amount of airflow and a distance from ionizer. Typical measurement values are as follows.
Distance | 20NI(0.01Mpa) | 60NI(0.08Mpa) | 250NI(0.5Mpa)
200mm | 0.018ppm | 0.009ppm | 0.003ppm
300m | 0.012ppm | 0.005ppm | 0.001ppm

===== [p26-26] DB-800 SERIES > 3.5.2 Note to Safety Cover Interlock (1块) =====
--[p26]-- 3.5.2 Note to Safety Cover Interlock
Safety cover is locked in closed state by electro-magnetic lock switch all the time while the machine is in operation. Accordingly, it is not possible to open the safety cover. The safety cover can only be opened when the machine is in stopped state.
Conversely, it is not possible to move all moving units in the machine while the safety cover is open.

===== [p60-61] ! CAUTION > 4.2.7 Dry Operation Method (2块) =====
--[p60]-- 4.2.7 Dry Operation Method
This section describes dry cycle operation for frame transfer, preform and bonding.
1) In case frames exist on track, remove them.
2) Select “Auto” button on main window.
3) While pressing move left (←), move right (→), move up (↑) or move down (↓) cursor switch, press START switch and a window to verify operation mode will appear.
4) In mode selection, bring “Dry cycle mode” to appear and press START switch so that the dry cycle operation will take place.
--[p61]-- For dry cycle operation, units related to frame transfer (feed claws, frame presser) and preform and or bonding head will move.
5) When STOP switch is pressed, the dry cycle operation is stopped.

===== [p6-6] DB-800 SERIES > 1.3.3 In case the equipment is moved using casters (option) (2块) =====
--[p6]-- (3) When the equipment moves by rolling casters, it may encounter the floor where the surface is not flat or bump appears. Therefore, place a metal plate or hard plastic plate, etc., over the floor in order not to apply any impact to the equipment, and then, carry it safely.
(4) In case height restriction with door and the like exists, remove the pilot light and carry the equipment.
--[p6]-- 1.3.3 In case the equipment is moved using casters (option)
(1) Raise adjusters until casters come in touch with floor.
(2) Carry the equipment with three (3) persons or more. It is recommended that one (1) person or more holds the equipment front side and two (2) persons or more hold the equipment rear side. In this case, be careful so as not to apply excessive load on acrylic cover, touch panel, operation panel and so forth.

===== [p7-7] DB-800 SERIES > 1.4 Installation method of equipment (3块) =====
--[p7]-- (7) Remove all ropes of nylon and others that rope up moving portion. After the removal, exercise the checking simultaneously.
(8) In accordance with operation manual, start the equipment.
--[p7]-- (4) Connect utilities at primary side. (Dry air, N2, vacuum, exhaust duct).
(5) Connect power cable of primary side. At this time, do not forget to take the ground. Connect power directly to distributor and make it sure that no looseness appears when tightening screws to terminals on the distributor.
(6) Upon installation of auxiliary modules and the like, check wafer cassette, pilot light, TV monitor and conversion kit and so forth.
--[p7]-- 1.4 Installation method of equipment
When the equipment should be installed, exercise installation in accordance with the following explanation.
(1) Turn adjuster bolts, one by one, so as to bring adjuster installation block bottom plane to 85mm±5mm above the floor and then, fix them respectively.
(2) Place a level over the base of the equipment to verify the level of the equipment and turn adjuster bolts to adjust the level.
(3) Turn nuts of adjuster bolts and fix the equipment.

===== [p8-8] DB-800 SERIES > 2.2 Handling Precautions (2块) =====
--[p8]-- 2.2 Handling Precautions
This manual describes several precautions needed when an operator handles a semiconductor assembling system. To operate the system safely and smoothly, the operator is required to verify and observe the following precautions in advance.
(1) When using this system, be sure to take the ground.
(2) Do not exercise operation in the state that any cover is detached. In addition, in case safety of cover cannot be detected, do not operate the equipment.
--[p8]-- (3) Do not touch any moving portion while the system is in motion. In addition, make it sure that any part of body is not mistakenly put within the range of movement of the machine.
(4) For a fuse and the like, use the one of specified rate. In addition, when changing a fuse, turn power switch to OFF position and then, exercise the change.
(5) Never touch high temperature portion where high temperature warning label is attached.
When it must be touched, make it sure that the applicable member is cooled down to room temperature and then, exercise the work.

===== [p8-8] DB-800 SERIES > 2.1 General (1块) =====
--[p8]-- 2.1 General
This system is a fully automatic, standalone machine that performs die bonding process for assembling IC and LSI. This system employs a method to pick up dies, one at a time, from a wafer attached to a tape of non-expanding type or expanding type basically. Setting inkdot, chipping and crack of die, etc., it picks up dies of good quality only. By loading wafer mapping data acquired after prober processing, it is also possible to perform die pick up processes by wafer mapping method.
